purpose: Recover a complete CloudStack graph for the reviewed Blob cases and check whole-repository preservation after fixed SQL regex caching. This is a declared operational follow-up, not a repeated performance qualification.
prerequisites: The registered four-file release comparison must finish with all 24 outcomes retained, all six complete graphs per file equal, and all candidate native checks passed. Freeze both release executables before this follow-up.

binaries.candidateIdentity: The frozen candidate hash in sql-regex-cache-01/checks.json and samples.json; it must be identical for the four-file and whole-repository arms.

extraction.scope: Entire clean pinned apache/cloudstack checkout, with default native discovery. No language or path exclusions added.
extraction.timing: Record wall time, UTC timestamps and host load as operational observations. One fixed-order run per version cannot establish a speedup or release-performance qualification.
extraction.isolation: No compilation or other extraction by this task during either run. Unrelated host work is disclosed; ordinary OS caches are not flushed.

comparison: Retain every timeout, limit failure, publication error and partial-graph warning. Hash each admitted complete graph; identical bytes establish whole-artifact equality. Different hashes do not establish semantic inequality without further review, and cannot earn equality credit. Report admission under both original 256 MiB and follow-up 1 GiB bounds.
laterQueries: Only a successfully published graph within the declared follow-up bound may supply the same eight-class Blob audit. Keep native ranking, source-assisted identity resolution and neighbor diagnostics distinct. Source truth and human Blob ratings cannot be substituted for native ranking output. Any query capture keeps the existing request and response limits.
preservation: Do not overwrite or reclassify either prior unoptimized CloudStack timeout, original graph-admission failures, or any Graphify artifact. Graphify skipped all 119 SQL inputs in its frozen environment; this follow-up is not a Graphify speed comparison.
forbiddenClaims: No whole-product, cross-language or held-out superiority from this follow-up.
No degree-to-god-object inference, true-negative inference from absent hub rows, or availability-to-correctness inference.
No timing ratio based on a timeout or incomparable build profiles.
